# Copilot instructions

Repo: analytics-dashboard (React + Vite).

## Dev
- npm install
- npm run dev
- npm run test

## Formatting
- Prettier and ESLint on save.
- 2-space indentation.

## Local tooling
- Install Node with your platform package manager; do not pipe remote scripts into a shell.
- Use npm scripts only.

## PRs
- Small PRs, descriptive titles, link the issue.
